facts.fact: WHO reports that in 2023 it supported the Ministry of Health to develop a five-year health information policy and strategy to guide implementation of the HMIS, and a five-year implementation roadmap setting out milestones, activities and resources for the country's health information systems; neither is said to be costed or adopted.

WHO describes the HMIS as the Ministry of Health's national health information system, to be strengthened by integrating other data collection and reporting systems into DHIS2, and says in 2023 that it is weakened by parallel systems run by implementing partners and short of skilled personnel to manage it.
